title: Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon 2026 Review: A 33-Year-Old Coastal Fixture
meta_description: Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon 2026 review: September 27, the 33rd edition of a long-running coastal race backed by Thailand Tri-League.
dek: Set for 27 September 2026, the 33rd edition of the Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon brings genuine multi-decade continuity to a beach-resort city about 100km southeast of Bangkok.
verdict: The Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon's 33rd edition is a genuine rarity among the races in this research batch: three-plus decades of continuous running gives it a track record that first- and second-year events simply can't match. Organised by Thailand Tri-League with four distances (4.5K to the full marathon), it takes place in Pattaya -- Thailand's eighth-largest city and a major tourism hub since the 1960s, easily reached from Bangkok. Six distinct source listings, from the official site to expat and sub-3-hour-marathon community pages, suggest a race with real visibility across multiple runner communities, even without individually quoted reviews on file.

sections.heading: Three Decades of Continuous Racing
paragraphs: The 2026 edition is the 33rd running of the Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon, organised by Thailand Tri-League. [1] That kind of multi-decade continuity is rare among the races covered in this research batch -- most of which are first, second, or third editions -- and typically signals a mature, well-tested operation with established sponsor relationships and community following.

sections.heading: Four Distances in a Major Tourist City
paragraphs: Distances offered are 4.5K, 10K, 21.1K and the 42.195K full marathon. [1] Pattaya is the second-largest city in Chonburi province and the eighth-largest in Thailand, on the Gulf of Thailand coast about 100km southeast of Bangkok, with a population of over 351,000 as of 2025. [2] Originally a small fishing village, tourism has driven its growth since the 1960s into a major resort city with correspondingly strong hotel, transport and event infrastructure.

sections.heading: Wide Community Visibility
paragraphs: Research turned up six distinct source listings for this race -- from the official Pattaya Marathon site to AIMS World Running's international calendar, expat community sites, and specialist pages like Sub3-Marathon.com. [1] That breadth of coverage across different runner communities (general tourism, expat, and serious performance-focused sites) suggests a race with genuine cross-cutting visibility, even though no individually attributed participant quotes were captured in this research.

sections.heading: Easy Bangkok Access
paragraphs: Pattaya's proximity to Bangkok -- roughly 100km, a well-travelled route with frequent bus and van connections -- makes this one of the more logistically simple international race trips in this research batch for travellers arriving via Thailand's main international gateway.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If a race with genuine multi-decade history, strong tourist-city infrastructure, and easy access from Bangkok appeals, the Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon's 33rd edition on 27 September 2026 is one of the more reliably established options in this research batch. Registration is currently open.
